title: Modeler DXF writer matrix cross-profile source-handle and history remap controls
mode: Generated local implementation and focused validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Assert first-export modeler handles are remapped from generated source handles for all matrix profiles and both DXF encodings.
Verify serialized 3DSOLID history group 350 references the remapped target.
Verify local import readback restores emitted modeler handles and the correct history edge.
Register a focused CTest so the cross-profile matrix can run without the full DWG local round-trip suite.

method.limitations: Generated writer output was read back by libdxfrw's own parser. This proves local wire/remap/readback consistency, not strict independent parser acceptance, ACIS semantics, or native-consumer behavior.

localCrosswalk.sourceHandle: Each generated modeler starts at handle 0xFC00 + its modeler index; first-export output must use a different nonzero handle.
localCrosswalk.historyReference: The AC1021+ history case's group 350 must equal the first modeler's emitted handle; import must restore that exact target, while non-history modelers retain a zero history handle.
localCrosswalk.externalEvidence: J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
